caveats: Mason sources are ~30 fps (or lower) screen recordings of Instagram posts; events are +-1 frame (~33 ms). With downswings of ~0.13-0.35 s, per-swing tempo uncertainty is large; treat aggregate tempo as +-15% at best (see tempo_rel_uncertainty).
Mason joint angles are 2D-image proxies from MediaPipe landmarks, not fitted 3D humanoid angles; view-dependent (mostly down-the-line, 1 oblique, 1 face-on).
Pelvis/thorax turn, X-factor and rotational sequencing are unavailable for Mason; sequencing uses arm joint angular-velocity peaks only, within [top, impact+0.15 s] and is a weak proxy.
Reported 'right_*' columns are the golfer's anatomical right (= LEAD arm for a lefty).
Quality weights = quality_score/(1+tempo_rel_uncertainty), normalised; quality_score is a heuristic ranking, not accuracy vs ground truth.
Mason's true speed (120+ mph, 300+ yd) is NOT derivable from this data; do not use these features for speed targets.
Handedness was not footage-verified (handedness_verified=False, relying on stated handedness) for mason_v2_p1_s11 and p2_s10; see per_swing flags.

Mason downswings are only ~4-6 source frames (median ~0.17 s), so the tempo ratio is quantised and per-swing relative uncertainty is ~0.14-0.32 (median ~0.27); the true downswing may well be longer than detected.
Small n; IQR is descriptive, not a confidence interval.

cmu_subject64.note: Recreational lab volunteer; slow (tempo ~1.7). Acknowledgment text required (docs/CMU_MOCAP_GOLF.md). Do not redistribute as a dataset.

multisense_cc0_right_handed.note: Published as CC0 but participants identifiable: needs counsel (docs/research_mocap_datasets_licenses.md). 88-103 mph club speed, right-handed, IMU mocap; legal sign-off pending (see docs/research_open_data_v2.md).

synthetic_scott.note: Procedurally generated from textbook params, not measured; tempo set to 3.0 by construction.

provenance.note: Mason's own swings recorded from an Instagram feed screen-recording; confirm no third-party content. Raw video not stored.

mason.selection: recommended & commercial_ok & !partial & native-left (+ p3_s09 un-mirrored flipped edit)

mason_slowmo_v3.caveat: Slow factor k is an order-of-magnitude estimate (anchors disagree by ~2x); only tempo_ratio and unique-frame counts are scale-free. Event detector differs from the v2 one, so tempo values are not directly comparable with mason.aggregate (v2).
